heading: Styling an embroidered kurti

p: An embroidered kurti is a single long top with thread or sequin work that you pair with your own bottoms – pants, palazzo, a skirt or jeans. Sheer embroidered kurtis look best over a slip or camisole; they are light, festive and easy to re-style for brunches, pujas and parties.

list: With straight pants and a dupatta for a puja or office celebration.
With palazzo for a relaxed festive look.
With jeans and juttis for brunch.
Over a slip dress or camisole if the fabric is sheer.
With a printed skirt for an indo-western party look.

faq: What do I wear under a sheer embroidered kurti?
A matching slip, camisole or a full-length inner in a similar shade – it keeps the embroidery visible without being see-through.
Can I wear an embroidered kurti with jeans?
Yes – a shorter embroidered kurti with straight or wide jeans and juttis is a popular indo-western look.
Is a kurti the same as a kurta set?
No – a kurti is the top alone; a kurta set includes matching bottoms and often a dupatta.
